studies.title: The sweet potato
studies.caption: Sweet potatoes form thick storage roots beneath spreading vines. Voyagers carried this American crop across the Pacific long before European ships followed.
studies.prompt: Low close view of Ipomoea batatas vines with heart-shaped leaves, one pale lilac funnel flower, a small freshly lifted cluster of elongated reddish storage roots resting on dark soil. Tropical garden, no potatoes or tubers growing above ground on vines.
